content:
Aisha Patel: quick heads up — CloudHarbor + AxiomIO confirmed for the Pan-EU technical roundtable on Jun 24. We need speaker order, live-demo handoff, and sample-kit customs plan.
Tom Rivers: great — tentative agenda? 45m panel + 25m demos + Q&A?
Jun Park: that works. propose: 1) 10m CloudHarbor overview, 2) 15m AxiomIO hardware demo, 3) 20m joint integration walkthrough, then Q&A.
Eileen (CloudHarbor): fine on timing. we'll need HDMI->USB-C dongle and access to our cloud tenant for the live run.
Rafa (AxiomIO): hardware will be on-site. can do AV check at 10:00 local the day before. bring spare power bricks.
Maria Lopez: swag and sample kits: customs lead time for DE/NL/FR is ~5 business days if declared as marketing samples. need HS codes and invoice value.
Aisha Patel: @Maria can you share HS codes? keep value <€45 to avoid VAT where possible.
Maria Lopez: yes. prelim list: sample unit (HS 8471.80), demo dongles (HS 8517.70). invoice line: "partner demo kit - no resale". i'll draft CN22 content.
Jun Park: demo failover plan: if live cloud tenant unavailable, fallback to pre-recorded local demo with the same prompts. I'll prepare a short script and a 2-min trimmed recording.
Tom Rivers: call tree for handoff: 1) MC introduces CloudHarbor -> hand to Eileen 2) Eileen triggers AxiomIO via integration -> Rafa takes hardware -> Jun wraps integration. Need one person to monitor latency.
Aisha Patel: OpsBot — can you create a checklist and remind us 7 days before for AV and 3 days before for customs pickup?
OpsBot: checklist created: https://redwood-internal/ops/checklists/pan-eu-roundtable-1967801234 — reminders set (7d AV, 3d customs). :white_check_mark:
Rafa (AxiomIO): small note on shipping: label prints require item SKU on the 2nd line or customs will flag. sample command we use:
```
lp-print-label --sku AXIO-DEVKIT-2026 --addr "Maria Lopez, Redwood Inference, C/O FreightHub" --pcs 5
```
Maria Lopez: thanks — i'll use that. also ask partners to avoid fragrance on swag — customs sometimes inspects.
Eileen (CloudHarbor): speaker bios are done. i'll send headshots and 1-paragraph blurbs by EOD tomorrow.
Jun Park: I'll record the fallback demo and upload to the shared drive: /shared/roundtables/pan-eu/demo-fallback.mp4
Tom Rivers: run-of-show draft: 09:00 venue doors, 09:15 start, 09:20 CloudHarbor, 09:30 AxiomIO hardware, 09:45 integration demo, 10:05 Q&A, 10:30 close + swag distribution. Thoughts?
Aisha Patel: looks good. can we add 5 extra minutes between AxiomIO -> integration for a quick stage swap?
Tom Rivers: yes will build a 5-min buffer.
Maria Lopez: sample-kit manifest I'll circulate — includes packing list and customs CN22. setting pick-up two days before event.
Eileen (CloudHarbor): we'll ship our tenant credentials to Jun via 1password item; will mark it expiring post-event.
Jun Park: received the 1password invite; will test creds 48h before.
Aisha Patel: perfect. last ask: please confirm headcounts for swag quantities by Friday so Maria can finalize customs paperwork. :pray: 
Rafa (AxiomIO): sending numbers tomorrow morning.
Tom Rivers: I'll update the public event page once we lock speaker order.
Aisha Patel: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for logistics. ping me for urgent blockers. :sparkles:
